threshold_decision.reason: The normalized 1%-validity radius is scale-free uniform (r_1%/Phi_local ~ 0.03 across B0-B4 and alpha), which is exactly why no DIMENSIONFUL universal cutoff is supported: the dimensioned |d| collapse levels (0.48-2.19 m/s at the anchors) and the gamma-direction topology-preserving radii (1.5e-7 - 2.4e-6 rad, ~16x spread) both vary across branches with no single numeric value separating grazing-adjacent from transverse.  Qualification uses continuous diagnostics (|d|, |sin gamma|, Phi_local clearance, validity radius, topology gate, REF stability).  exact n^T f^- = 0 remains GRAZING/NONTRANSVERSE; small finite denominators are never auto-rejected.  G6R RE-AUDIT (refined bracketed+bisected radii): r_1%/Phi_local ~ 0.0403-0.0408 and r_5%/Phi_local ~ 0.191-0.197 are scale-free uniform across branches and alpha -> still no dimensionful universal cutoff is supported.  The refined radii are bracketed [PASS, FAIL] and bisected (deterministic), superseding the coarse G6 grid-sampled lower bounds (0.03/0.10).

numerical_resolution_note: controlled families stop at the first REF-unstable layer (NUMERICAL_RESOLUTION_LIMIT); no such point is called 'the exact grazing point'.

g6r.rationale: G6R corrective patch: hardened extraction contract, refined operational radii (bracket+bisection), paired radial plateau and full 4-column paired-map FD validation, event-direction class enforcement, dual-reference lock.
